response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT u.acctscope AS acctscope, COUNT(*) AS n FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT acctscope, n AS risk_margin_record_count, n * 1.0 / SUM(n) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, n * 1.0 / AVG(n * 1.0) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM c

assumptions.assumption: orders.recordvault and users.userstamp are unique, so joins do not duplicate risk/margin records; each risk/margin row counts once.
Users with a NULL acctscope form their own group (NULL scope) and are included in the total and average; the request does not mention excluding them.
The average is taken over scopes that have at least one matched record; scopes with zero matched records do not appear and are not included in the average.
